about: Question 10 (A), decided by the owner on 2026-09-16. Control test 4.7 holds today's engine to this written prediction of how its capture of the control corpus differs from the stored control capture (tools/control-corpus.json, controlCapture): every difference with its kind, scenario, path, and reference and candidate values, exactly as tools/differential-harness.js reports them. A difference found and not declared, or declared and not found, fails 4.7; a category or a pattern approves nothing. An output-moving commit declares its differences here, with its reason under changes, before it lands. Historical integrity, whether the stored capture is what its own engine computed, is a separate check (tools/historical-replay.js). Restarted on 2026-10-03 against s5aa-r51-control (S5AA R51, the owner's successor-control decision): every declaration made against s5-control (62 changes, 15971 differences, S5 R5 to S5AA R50) is kept in this file's history at 5119d03; against the successor, only movement since b722884 is declared.
